basis: Full Y2KCRISIS conversation and the original GAYBOY homepage

requirements.feature: Accounts, handles, profiles, avatar uploads and pronouns
GAYBOY is an app and its page uses the same homepage renderer and editable template as members
Live homepage builder; twelve movable blocks per page; sidebar and single-column layouts
Editable title, welcome banner, tagline, ticker, quote, interests, mood, contact links and footer
Colors, background patterns, uploaded wallpaper, fonts, borders, cursors, rounded panels and glitter controls
YouTube videos, playlists, Shorts and live links play in-page
SoundCloud tracks/playlists, Spotify, Vimeo, Mixcloud, Twitch and Bandcamp embed-code players
Direct audio/video files and one featured sidebar soundtrack
Uploaded photos, image galleries, pocket collections, lists, downloads and large buttons
Badges, dividers, stamps and under-construction signs
Optional visitor counter and a personal page update note
Buddy requests, accepted buddy list, eight featured friends, presence and custom away messages
AIM-style floating messenger, minimizes, stays open between pages, private history controls and optional sounds
Public chatrooms plus member-hosted rooms with title, topic, color, uploaded wallpaper, capacity and privacy
Visible room participants, shared media player, saved versus live-session history
Room hosts appoint moderators; moderators remove messages, ban and unban
No likes, follower totals, public collection scores, streaks, read receipts or typing pressure
Guestbook notes and actual freehand doodles, approval controls and owner removal
Private postcards; recipient chooses whether to display them publicly
Finite pin objects; three starter pins; giving transfers ownership; consensual atomic trades
Pin creator and ownership history; one-of-ones or fixed editions of two/three with no later expansion
Pins, current-tag stickers and stamps can be positioned and rotated on a homepage jacket
Optional private pin tin: display only pins placed on the jacket
Creative profile achievements unlock finite creation tokens; no engagement grinding
One active sticker/tag; replacing it prevents old-tag placement; old bathroom marks retain their original artwork
Paint pencil, brush, eraser, fill, eyedropper, undo/redo, transparency, grid and actual-size preview
Uploaded images become pixelated, reduced-palette sticker artwork
Editable text/image layers, 8-bit/graffiti/ransom/bubble/handwriting fonts, dragging, scaling and rotation
Sticker outlines and PNG export; same editor makes pins
Bathroom sticker graffiti and font-rendered quotes, placement and rotation, disable/friends/approval settings
Bathroom owner moderation, archived marks and restoring them without erasing history
Directory search, recently updated pages, random discovery and opt-in neighborhoods
User-created webrings with join/leave, previous/next and random wandering
Finite chronological bulletin board, replies, monthly community questions and decorating prompts
Blocking, per-feature privacy, content reports and host moderation
Original GAYBOY ROM, tutorial, controls, save export and in-browser app playback
GAYBOY beat capture/share, playback links and restoring the visitor's own beat
Typed uWu becomes a custom emo/scene-face emoji with a long center bang in rooms and DMs; picker and common emoticons

added_features: Recoverable local homepage and paint drafts
Ten saved versions per page and restore controls
Up to eight additional customizable pages with clean /~handle/page addresses
One-time recovery codes; password recovery invalidates old sessions
Automatic media-provider detection and a phone preview in the builder
provider_limits: Embedded services control availability, geographic restrictions and login requirements. Playback starts with visitor interaction. Bandcamp requires its official embed URL/code. Generic arbitrary iframe HTML is not executed.
